notes.title: Bugfixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello there

This is update with mixed content. There are some bugfixes and other improvements for performance and enemies.

- Updated game engine
- Fixed bug where you could jump through the ceiling sometimes
- Improved management for small pieces when you cut a single object many times
- Fixed a bug where the droid stopped firing from a certain angle
- Improved drone move detection. They will hit walls less accidentally.
- Fixed Z-Fighting on some Door/Wall configuration
- Added sleep for physics calculation for stationary objects like large boxes to save performance
- Improved sound sphere configuration for better 3D effect for projectiles

notes.title: JUMP improvement and more fixes
notes.content:
Hello there

I've always wanted to make Saber Fight a physically active game. Quick dodges, dynamic reaction, fancy moves. That's why I decided to add jumping with a physical jump. It was an experiment, I knew it might not be comfortable in the long run. Certainly, there will be hardcore people who like such a challenge, but I would like Saber Fight to be for everyone, not forcing them to play the way I like it, but the way everyone likes it in their own way.

- Added jumping on button (press down on rotation controller)
- Fixed double sabers blades (deflection, blade behavior, minor errors)
- Fixed camera effects when taking damage
- Fixed saber sparks on walls
- [Occulus Touch] Added interaction with UI via Trigger (except X / A)

notes.title: Deflection Update
notes.content:
Hello there

Deflecting projectiles is one of the biggest challenges for a saber user. Many of you mentioned that it can be annoying. I saw a lot of your videos and comments (I watch all of them). I noticed how to improve deflection to be more enjoyable, more satisfying, and more suited to the gameplay.

Active Deflection:
- Changed the aiming method. The deflections are much more accurate. They automatically select the origin target (+ - 15cm) instead of choosing the general projectile direction (+ - 2*)
- Projectiles are faster (2.5x -> 3x)
- Projectile deal more damage (x3)

Passive Deflection:
- The ability to aim has been added. Now the projectiles will be deflected in the direction we are looking instead of in a random direction.
- Projectiles are faster (1x -> 2x)
- Projectile deal more damage (x2)

Others:
- Base deflection collider size increased (0.02 -> 0.025)
- Equipment slots on the belt have been moved a little forward
- Fixed bug - At certain angles, the blade collider disappeared



Did you know that the deflection collider dynamically increases its radius depending on the swing speed? It can go from 0.025 to 0.200. Give it a try, you might be surprised how easier it is to hit with a fast blade swing than with a static cover.

notes.title: Physics Update - Cut and Deflection improvement
notes.content:
Hello there

While trying to fix the sword's feeling of heaviness (there shouldn't be any lag) I found some problems in physics, so I prepared this fix. Physical interactions should now be more reliable.

- The accuracy of the physical calculations has been increased
- Collision detection for projectiles has been improved
- Improved the method of calculating the blade speed - Now the results will be more stable
- Fixed object double cut bug
- Fast cut detection improved - The blade will now pass through the target much less frequently
- Changed the way the physics interact with the sword in hand (this may solve the weight and responsiveness issues)
- Physics computing resource management has been improved - Optimization
- Sword rotation resistance reduced - Now quick spinning while throwing should be easier
- Fixed blade collider bug shrinking to 0 during passive deflection
- Changed detection thresholds for active deflection - Now it should be a little easier

Let me know in the comments if this solves your recent problems.

notes.title: Level Generator Rework - Big Content Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello there[/b]

The level generator rework is finally ready. This is one of the biggest updates in the game. The work was time-consuming and complicated because it touches many aspects of the game, from small props to enemies and entire rooms.

I have focused right now on changing how the rooms are created and how much they can be modified by the generator. Thanks to more variables and more pre-calculations, the levels will not only be more interesting but also run much faster. This will allow to fill them with more content and it will open up new paths for development. 
This is a very important update that will allow me to focus on other level-dependent elements such as enemy behavior or interaction with the world.

The update also includes fixes for enemies. Their positions are now completely randomized taking into account the layout and content of the rooms.
In addition to the improvements to the systems, new elements were also created from which levels can be built (walls, doors, obstacles, decorations).

[b]Levels[/b]
- All old levels (25) have been reworked and improved - more variants, more objects, and improved design
- 8 new levels have been added
- Added new object categories (7 -> 14) - From micro props like a small pistol to much larger piles of materials or entire blockades that you will have to break through (corridor obstacles coming soon!).
- Added 43 new interactive objects (28 -> 71)
- Multiple door support - Levels randomize entry and exit from each possible door. Previously, only some levels had an inverted variant. Now, if there are 5 doors on the level, the generator can use each of them as an enter/exit.
- Randomization of walls - This will allow differentiating the walls with small details that can play an important role (hole through which drones can fly in, ventilation, etc.)
- Improved level resource management system - Levels load faster, take up less memory, run smoother and clean their resources better. 
- Improved lighting - Better transparency, prettier and faster for your PC

[b]Enemies[/b]
- Stationary enemies spawn - Enemies will be able to spawn in completely new places if the conditions allow them (obstacles, presence of other enemies, the slope of the terrain, etc.)
- Hidden enemies spawn - Now, as optional opponents, they wait in secret for the right moment to surprise the player instead of simply jumping out of the walls when you enter the room.

[b]Others[/b]
- Increased performance (up to 100% - 300%) - Improved resource management on levels, optimization of effects, light, and physics.
- The door generation system has been rebuilt - Doors are now very important in resource management. They are prepared to handle many more locks and variants (More door-cutting experience coming soon!)
- A new version of the magnetic lock has been added
- A new door variant has been added
- Fixed enemies accidentally activating before entering the room



Be aware, such a large update can cause a lot of new bugs. I try to fix them all regularly. If something is wrong, let me know in the comments and I will take care of it immediately.
Big updates are sometimes necessary, but I think small updates with playable content work better. I will try to focus on them now. The new systems now give me a lot of opportunities to add new gameplay stuff.

notes.title: New Level Generator - Work in Progress
notes.content:
Hello there.

It's been a long time since the last update. This is because I am still working on a level generator rework. It takes a lot more work than I thought. The generator deals with many nested aspects of the game, and I want to prepare a stable version that won't break some other features.

Work on this update also includes a ton of other related fixes. I have already managed to do:

- A complete change in the way levels are combined. Support for multi-door. You will be able to enter the location from all sides. Much fewer cases where rooms overlap with walls. Much less Z-Fighting. 
- Several new rooms. 
- New doors and locks.
- New lighting and props
- A dynamic spawn system that allows enemies to position themselves in completely new random places.
- Performance has quadrupled!

There is much more to come and im here all the time to make things done!. My main focus right now is to make the levels more varied, filled with more interesting objects to mess around with like pipes, batteries, consoles, force fields (?).

I hope you will like it.
See you soon.

notes.title: Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello there

I thought you might find it interesting what I plan to do in the future of the project. I really like this project and would like to develop it until it becomes a solid VR game! (and maybe more?). Unfortunately, I'm only one man, so these things will take some time. Thanks to the support of the community, there are people who want to help with graphics or 3D modeling! I really appreciate that.

Some of the most important things I will work on in the future are:

Level Generator Update
- More levels
- More objects in levels
- Better variation of opponents
- More randomness

Saber Experience Update
- Better control of Saber
- More types of Sabers
- Complete sound and visual effects
- Better collisions
- Support for Haptics

Temple Update
- Brand new temple
- New temple parts repair system
- Complex machinery requiring replacement of parts (batteries, components)
- Component looting system from enemy warehouses

Enemies Update
- More types of enemies
- More complex droid behavior
- More Doorlocks
- More obstacles in the levels

The order is random, I will start doing any of these updates when the time is right. Between them there will be many smaller updates with bugfixes and additional content. Now I'm working on resolving the problems that arose after updating the software. These are serious, I can't post the update right now because I'm afraid you may have these problems in the game.

Have patience, work is in progress.

notes.title: TACTICAL MAP UPDATE
notes.content:
After a long time, I finally finished updating the tactical map. Now you can finally decide what mission to choose due to strategic factors. Thanks to your strategic thinking, you can use the gaps in your opponent's defense to your advantage and attack where they are weak, or if you are looking for a challenge, you can choose the most protected location and destroy everyone.

Now each location has functions on the map. For example, droid bases can send additional units to other locations, other buildings can coordinate combat operations by increasing the rate of fire of drones etc. By destroying locations, you eliminate its impact on other locations making missions easier.

This update took me much longer than I thought because i was ill, but this will not stop me from making more updates. Global modifiers affecting missions are a complicated thing and I will definitely add more of them.

notes.title: Tutorial Hotfix
notes.content:
In the tutorial there was an error at the very end, preventing you from entering the temple. This is now fixed.

I have sent an early version of the TACTICAL MAP update. More information in the next update.

notes.title: Mission Map Update
notes.content:
The new mission panel is finally here! It was probably one of the most underdeveloped elements, but now it looks good and will be much better.

[ADDED] - New mission map model
[ADDED] - New locations on the mission map
[ADDED] - New GUI for mission location
[ADDED] - Twice as many location definitions
[ADDED] - Better positioning of mission miniatures
[ADDED] - Difference in level generation complexity
[ADDED] - Difference in difficulty levels

[FIXED] - Deselecting missions
[FIXED] - Reflections of the map material
[FIXED] - Problems with lighting in the temple

When designing missions, I wanted to give you the opportunity to make tactical decisions by choosing where and when you want to play. I've always wanted to make a single mission part of a larger picture. Make player decisions affect the map. Soon it will be done. This is just the first part of TACTICAL MAP UDATE. In the next part, there will be mission modifiers and location effects. Hope you will like it.

notes.title: Hints, Bugfixes and Preparation for bigger update
notes.content:
I have recently sent some small updates. Most are minor improvements. I have also added some new small elements like the hint system. Sometimes I see that you encounter problems in the game that you can easily avoid,new hints should help here. This update contains elements that are preparation for the larger Tactical Map Rework.

- Added new hint system
- Added new sounds for falling objects
- Added 2 new slicable objects (plates for hints)
- Changed 2 slicable object to use Hint system
- Fixed throwing saber through the wall
- Fixed missing bindings for some controllers

notes.title: Saber Detection Hotfix
notes.content: Finally I managed to fix the collision detection in fast saber swings. It took me a while, but things should be much better now. The feeling of cutting is now much satisfying. This is an experimental solution, so some more complex objects may behave strangely. I also improved the visual view of temple plates.

notes.title: Gameplay Content Update! New Levels!
notes.content:
It took me some time but its finally ready, the Content Update is here. Are you bored of current level setting? Not any more! This update add more than twice new objects and levels. There are also improvements for current levels, bether level generation and enemy spawning. Hope you will like it.

[ADDED] 10 new levels
[ADDED] 15 new slicable objects
[ADDED] New elements for current levels
[ADDED] New improved doors
[ADDED] New enemy spawn locations
[ADDED] Improved level generation
[ADDED] Improved lighting for locations

[CHANGED] More tolerance for cutting angles
[CHANGED] More variety in enemies spawning
[CHANGED] Amount of enemies

[FIXED] More save position resetting

New level generator can create more complex levels by creating multiple doors to different corridors/rooms. Rooms can now lead upwards or downwards. Some doors are closed but this will enable in future to create some dead ends or secret places.

notes.title: Grab and Movement hotfix
notes.content:
There were some strange problems with grabbing saber in some cases. Now it's finally fixed.

[FIXED] - Grabbing Saber issues
[FIXED] - Catching Saber after pull issues
[FIXED] - Swapping hand grab issues
[FIXED] - Turning On/Off issues
[FIXED] - Swapping hand for movement/rotation for Oculus/Index

notes.title: More improvements for Saber throwing
notes.content:
This small patch adds very important improvement for Saber throwing:

- Added spin boost for more deadly throw
- Added Interia corrector for a better align for the saber in the air

notes.title: HP System and Hit Indicators added!
notes.content:
This important update will add the long-awaited improved HP system and hit indicators. Many visual effects have been added and damage mechanics have also been expanded. This will give you more transparency in combat for better understanding when you were hit, by what type of projectile and how long can you stand.

Now the player can monitor his health level on a small panel on his right hand. After receiving a hit, HP is reduced by soft and hard damage.If you will fight well, soft HP damage can be recovered.

- Added HP Panel
- Added Soft/Hard damage types
- Added HP regeneration
- Added visual effect for getting hit
- Added impact sounds for projectiles
- Added new sounds set for different projectiles
- Added bether Player hitbox detection for dodging
- Changed Pellet projectile behaviour (it's more fragile type of projectile, now will dissolve after contact with saber)
- Changed cooldown of snap rotation from 0.35s to 0.25s
- Fixed minor bugs in Settings Panel

notes.title: More Settings Added!
notes.content:
This is small update with important settings addon and bugfixes.

- Added "Unstuck" Button
- Added "Restart Tutorial" Button
- Added "Return to Temple" Button
- Reduced snap rotation cooldown from 0.5 to 0.35
- GUI collision disabled

"Unstuck" option can help you reset your position if your movement is corrupted somehow.

notes.title: More Settings Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello there.

I have completed a basic set of option settings that you often mentioned. Now you can set the volume of sound and music or mute them separately. I have also added more movement configuration options. I hope you will like it.

In the meantime, I have fixed some bugs you have noticed:
- Fixed move direction after snap rotation for Swing/Grab Movement
- Fixed door closing/opening
- Fixed "Press Trigger" in Tutorial 
- Changed rotation for Vive Controller on Left trackpad only

In next days i will send some small sneaky updates for more control in free rotation speed and option for swapping Movement and Rotation to different hand.

notes.title: More Settings and Quality of Movement
notes.content:
Hello there.

Many of you ask about adding settings to the game and increasing the quality of movement. Good news for you im working right now on new Settings Panel with some basic things like sounds, rotation method, and other movement things. Update will be ready soon.

Thanks to your feedback, I was able to locate more issues and fix them. There has been a silent update with:
- Added automatic recovery of lost saber
- Fix for not receiving resources issue

Are there any option settings that you would particularly like to see? Let me know in the comments.

notes.title: Rotation for smooth movement added.
notes.content:
This is small update with rotation for smooth movement. You asked many times for it and here it is!

[b]Snap-Rotation[/b]:
- HTC Vive: Press left/right Trackpad
- Oculus Touch: Use right joystick
- Valve Knuckles: Use right joystick

By the way, I corrected some other small things:
- Saber On / Off sound volume reduced
- Added 3D effect for Saber On / Off sound
- Added coliders in Score Screen to prevent falling into void (Many thanks to .キャプテン™ for reporting this)
- [Valve Knuckles] Changed grip method for holding

notes.title: Controllers update is here! New movement method!
notes.content:
Based on your support, I have prepared a new controller mapping. I think this is much better configuration, I hope you will like it.

Many of you have asked for smooth movement, so I added a new movement. Now you can move freely using the Joystick / Trackpad. The simplest solutions are the best.

I have added a panel for you in which you will be able to choose what type of movement you prefer. Interactions with the GUI have also been improved. The tutorial has been reset to help you learn new controls.

[b]HTC Wand[/b]
Movement: Trackpad
Grab things: Grip
Sword On / OFF: Trigger
Use Power: Offhand Grip
Pull sword back: Main Hand Grip;
MENU: Button Menu
GUI Interaction: Trigger

[b]Oculus Touch[/b]
Movement: Joystick
Grab things: Grip
Sword On / OFF: Trigger
Use Power: Offhand Grip
Pull sword back: Main Hand Grip;
MENU: Y/B
GUI Interaction: X/A

[b]Valve Knuckles[/b]
Movement: Joystick
Grab things: Grip
Sword On / OFF: A
Use Power: Offhand Trackpad
Pull sword back: Main Hand Trackpad;
MENU: B
GUI Interaction: Trigger

If you think something can be configured better, write suggestions in the comment.
You also asked about the option of smooth rotation on the second controller. This option will be added shortly, I wanted to give you better control as soon as possible.

notes.title: Hello there, i will try to answer some of your questions in advance.
notes.content:
Soon the game will be available to everyone on January 3. Surely you have many questions, i will try to answer some of them in advance.

[h1]Updates?[/h1]
[b]I will keep developing the game[/b]. In the future, i would like to add elements such as more combat mechanics, more enemies, more locations and expand everything that is currently in the game. I will try to add playable content to the game with every update. For starters, however, I will focus on bugfixes.

[h1]VR support?[/h1]
I officially support [b]HTC Vive[/b] devices. I have added [b]Valve Index[/b] support, but I'm not sure how it will work because I only have one headset (HTC Vive Pro).
Im just simple dude like you. If you have suggestions for better mapping for Knuckles controllers, write in the comment what to replace.

In the future I would like to expand supported devices with Oculus, Vive Cosmos.

I am a big Sci-Fi fan and I have created this game with passion for each of you. So that you can have fun and make child-dream become real.
